pages.text: $(o)An oathsworn knight who never left his arena in the Nether. Its gates open only to a key won inside.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() He marks one of you and opens rifts. Whoever is marked should keep away while the rest strike.$(br2)Find the key before you look for him.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Oathbreaker Seal$() counts for the quest book.
